text:
Nina Park: Heads-up: partner wants marketplace listing + joint press. Legal/Sec need to confirm which compliance artifacts we can surface publicly (SOC, pen-test, questionnaire). Target announce date is 2024-07-08. Can we get sign-off by Fri?

Ethan Cole: Copy. Drop the current proposed artifact bundle here and any draft copy. Also confirm if partner requires redaction or embargo. We shouldn't claim "SOC2-compliant" unless partner gives us exact attestation wording.

Rohit Sharma: Security input: safe public bundle = attestation cover page (no control matrix), 1-paragraph pen-test finding summary (no IPs/hostnames, redact tool output), and a sanitized architecture diagram. Questionnaires can be summarized "completed" but never publish raw answers.

Lena Ortiz: Legal: prefer this phrasing for SOC: "Partner holds SOC2 Type II attestation covering security principles; details available to partners under NDA." Avoid listing control IDs or implying scope beyond that wording. Need to review draft PR copy before partner sees.

Jules Kim: I'll coordinate artifact packaging. Plan: create a manifest.csv, generate presigned S3 urls (7d), and attach redaction notes. Who owns the pen-test summary?

Nina Park: Assign owners: SOC cover: Lena; Pen summary: Rohit; Arch diagram: Jules. Partner signed an MSA + NDA in April — Marco confirmed in the PM thread, but I'm happy to re-check.

artifacts-bot: Uploaded: partnerY_arch_public_v2.svg (owner: Jules Kim)

Jules Kim: Presign command we'll use:

```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-internal/marketplace/partnerY/partner_soc_cover_redacted.pdf --expires-in 604800
```

Jules Kim: Note: we will not include raw scan outputs, sample traces, or screenshots with identifiable data. Create redacted PDFs for examples.

Rohit Sharma: On the pen summary: I'll strip technical indicators and include a CVSS-high/medium/low tally and a short remediation status line. Proposed one-liner for PR: "Independent testing found no critical vulnerabilities; a subset of findings were addressed prior to certification." Thoughts?

Lena Ortiz: That line is ok but softer: "Independent assessment identified findings that were remediated prior to final reporting." Also add embargo clause: "Embargo until 2024-07-08 10:00 PT; redistribution requires written consent."

Ethan Cole: Timeline: Legal needs the draft PR + artifact list by Thu EOD to meet partner review window. Partner wants 48h to respond.

Nina Park: I'll share the PR draft now in #marketing-drafts and tag partner PM. Jules, please drop manifest and presigns by Fri 11am.

Jules Kim: Will do. Manifest columns: filename, owner, presign_url, expiry, redaction_notes. I'll post the CSV with presigns once generated.

Rohit Sharma: FYI security will run a final quick check on redacted doc versions Thu AM. Ping me in DMs if anything looks suspect.

Lena Ortiz: I'll prepare the legal approval checklist: 1) Attestation language verified; 2) No raw control matrices; 3) Pen summary redacted; 4) Embargo clause present; 5) Partner NDA confirmed.

Ethan Cole: Great. If partner requests deeper redaction that breaks the narrative we'll escalate to PMs and ask for alternate language.

Nina Park: Thanks all. If anyone can't hit their owner date, call it out now so we can reassign. :handshake:
